gather.about: a sprig tells the player she is picking it up

bow.about: someone bows to the player as she passes

tea.about: she has reached the tea house: the ending begins

arrange.about: she sets her blossom in the vase

empty-handed.about: she reached the tea house with nothing to give

stem.about: the next ikebana stem (1 tall, 2 middle, 3 low) goes into the vase
